rule.summary: one REV ticket per session from the unchanged FTN Month 9 kernel, evaluated on bar-derived DayContext at every 15m close inside the killzone; direction from the raid; stop beyond the raid's own extreme
rule.kernel: ftn.research.kernel_log.session_ticket_log with config interpretation_triggers all false (ftn/config.yaml as pinned) -> ftn.os.candidates.evaluate_candidates; first selection in the session is the ticket
rule.sessions: London killzone 02:00-05:00 and NY AM killzone 07:00-10:00, America/New_York wall clock; kernel evaluated at each 15m close from start+15m to end inclusive, using only bars up to that close
rule.direction: REV: high raided -> bearish (short), low raided -> bullish (long); both or neither raided -> no ticket (ftn.models.rev.rev_direction)
rule.entry: close of the 15m bar on which the kernel first selects REV
rule.stop: bearish: raid_extreme_high + 1 pip; bullish: raid_extreme_low - 1 pip. raid_extreme = max high / min low of the 15m bars from the raid bar (first bar through the raided level, mss_meta.raid_bar_index) to the entry bar inclusive. 1 pip = evidence.pip = 1.0 index point (ftn.research.daycontext). Fallback without a raid bar: raided level +/- 1 pip
rule.target_and_exit: fixed 2R from entry; else time exit at the last 1m close before 16:00 NY; if one 1m bar touches stop and target, the stop counts (ftn.research.outcomes.simulate)
rule.tradeable: every research-draft gate passes except allowlist and the I0 contract gate (ftn.research.kernel_log.tradeable); the D18 direction gate and the stop-side risk gate stay as safety nets
rule.context_history: the kernel needs >= 22 prior sessions of 1m bars as context; context bars may come from before the counting window (never counted)

primary_metric: pooled mean R per trade after costs

statistical_test.hypothesis: one-sided: pooled mean R per trade after costs > 0
statistical_test.binding_bound: session-cluster percentile bootstrap. Clusters = (date, killzone) over counted trades pooled across US100 and US500, in canonical order (date, london before ny_am). rng = random.Random(20261004); 10,000 resamples; each resample draws k clusters with rng.randrange(k) (k = number of clusters) and computes sum(R)/count(trades). Sorted values v[0..9999]. Binding one-sided 95% lower bound = v[int(0.05*10000)] = v[500] (the 5th percentile; alpha = 0.05 one-sided). PASS needs v[500] > 0
statistical_test.p_value_for_family_rule: one-sided p = (#{v <= 0} + 1) / 10,001 from the same cluster bootstrap
statistical_test.percentile_warning: ftn.research.stats.boot_ci(alpha=0.05) returns v[250], the 2.5th percentile (a two-sided 95% / one-sided 97.5% bound). It is NOT the binding call. The harness implements the cluster bootstrap itself and a unit test asserts the binding index is 500
statistical_test.co_report_trade_level: trade-level percentile bootstrap, same seed and resample count, one-sided 95% lower bound = ftn.research.stats.boot_ci(R, alpha=0.10)[0] (non-binding)
statistical_test.multiplicity: H015b has one primary hypothesis. Promotion is governed by the family rule (family_rule below); FTN-H001..H013 conditioning reads may be co-reported as exploratory only

power_calculation.formula: clusters k = ((z_alpha + z_beta) * sigma_c / delta)^2 with sigma_c^2 = var_c(sum_c R - mean * n_c) / mbar^2; N_trades = k * mbar

assumptions.delta: +0.15 R per trade after costs (same bar as H013/H015)

power_calculation.design_effect: DEFF 1.425: H015's N=579 was the independent-trades value; same-killzone US100/US500 trades are correlated (rho(R) = 0.554 on 134 two-instrument clusters)
power_calculation.expected_duration: ~0.87 killzone clusters per trading day with a trade (1.615 trades each) on the exploratory tape -> N=824 is ~585 trading days (~28 months); trade rate unverified forward
power_calculation.joint_power_note: the six pass criteria are AND-ed and the kill and futility rules can stop a true edge, so the joint P(pass) is below the 0.80 single-test power; reported, not tuned. Simulation: clustered paths of the burned trades re-centred to mu, normal-approximation cluster SE for the bounds, foil approximated as median -0.18 + 1.645*SD/sqrt(N) (research/evidence/quant/H015b_POWER_SIM_2026-10-04.py)

binding_kill.rule: pooled cumulative R after costs <= -45R at any point from the first counted trade (canonical order: date, killzone, US100 before US500, entry time) -> FAILS (kill), stop counting
binding_kill.justification: clustered paths of the burned FTN-D22 trades re-centred (whole (date, killzone) clusters resampled, 2,000 paths of 824 trades, seed 20261004, futility off): P(kill | +0.15R) = -30R 4.65%, -35R 2.85%, -40R 1.35%, -45R 0.80%, -50R 0.40%, -55R 0.20%; -45R is the least negative level with P(kill | +0.15R) < 1%. With futility on (3,000 paths): P(kill | +0.15) 0.57%, (+0.10) 2.8%, (0.0) 30.2%, (-0.10) 70.5%

binding_futility.rule: fires ONCE, at exactly the 200th counted pooled trade (canonical order); never re-evaluated (no repeated peeking). Same session-cluster bootstrap on those 200 trades (clusters cut at trade 200 kept partial), seed 20261004, 10,000 resamples: upper one-sided 97.5% bound = v[int(0.975*10000) - 1] = v[9749]. If v[9749] < +0.10R -> FAILS (futility), stop counting
binding_futility.replaces: H015's non-binding 'futility read at N>=200 -> recommend FAILS to CASSANDRA'
binding_futility.operating_characteristics: simulated (normal-approx cluster SE, 3,000 paths, K -45R): P(futility | +0.15) 1.3%, (+0.10) 2.9%, (0.0) 8.9%, (-0.10) 17.6%; sensitivity N=900: joint P(pass | +0.15) 0.791

binding_pass_at_N: pooled session-cluster bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound v[500] > 0 (statistical_test.binding_bound)

random-entry foil (same day + killzone, random minute, random side, same risk_pts / 2R target / costs / 16:00 exit; 2,000 replicates; ftn.research.score.foil method per instrument with seed 20261004, pooled per replicate as the trade-weighted mean of the non-None outcomes) >= 95th percentile, pooled. Each replicate's N (outcomes that are not None) is logged and reported (min / median / max)
mean R after costs > 0 on US100 and on US500 separately
pooled mean with the top 1% of trades by R dropped > 0
pooled mean with small-stop trades (risk_pts < sample p25, per instrument) excluded > 0
binding_fail: kill line at any time, futility at trade 200, or failing any pass criterion at N = 824 = FAILS

verdict_wording.pass: a pass is recorded as 'PASSES (unadjusted)'; it becomes SURVIVES only under family_rule
verdict_wording.below_100: no verdict or edge wording below N=100 counted trades (counts and data-quality only)

family_rule.applies: a PASSES (unadjusted) becomes MINT-clearable SURVIVES only if its primary one-sided p (p_value_for_family_rule, the session-cluster bootstrap) clears Holm across the active family: with three tests at one-sided alpha 0.05 the thresholds are 0.0167 / 0.025 / 0.05 (smallest p first). Otherwise 'PASSES (unadjusted), replication required'
family_rule.never_relaxed: kills and the binding futility rule are per-test and are never relaxed by the family rule
family_rule.why: three independent-ish tests at alpha 0.05: ~14% chance that at least one passes by luck with no edge
family_rule.co_report: ORION's non-binding Holm co-report across H013 / H014 / H015b is kept in every report
